name: Spirit Blade: Ascension: additional cost return a Sword to material; fetch a Sword to field
notes: Spirit Blade: Ascension is CRUX element (champion CardID-patched to Lorraine, Crux Knight to unlock it). Its ability (cardActivatedAbilities["N0ipz8UWwf:0"]) requires controlling a REGALIA,SWORD on the field to return to material, then lets you fetch a REGALIA,SWORD from material or banishment onto the field. Clarent, Sword of Peace is seeded directly onto the field as the Sword to return; Warrior's Longsword is seeded into material as the Sword to fetch back -- final state shows Clarent back in myMaterial (p1Material-4) and Warrior's Longsword on myField (p1Field-1). An earlier draft opened with the two-pass 'P1 myHealth-0 Pass, P2 myHealth-0 Pass' idiom used elsewhere in this deck to reach a later turn's material phase -- but Clarent's own BEOP fast action makes P1's single decline of it end P1's entire turn 1 outright (unlike decks with nothing eligible for BEOP to offer), handing priority to P2 before the card was ever played, so the subsequent myHand-7!FSM! play silently no-op'd (ActionMap's myHand case requires playerID===turnPlayer and just breaks otherwise, no WARN). The swap never happened -- the notes above describing the final state were themselves written against that broken run and were wrong; the weak TurnEffects/zone_count-only assertions didn't catch it either. Fixed by dropping the two-pass opener: the initial gamestate already starts in P1's own turn-1 MAIN phase.

rulesClauses: Additional cost: Return a Sword regalia you control to your material deck. Choose a Sword regalia card from your material deck or banishment and put it onto the field.
